name: ENS (Esquema Nacional de Seguridad)
reference: CCN-STIC-807 'Criptología de empleo en el ENS' (Mayo 2022) §4.1 TLS: ¶61 (TLS 1.2/1.3 only), ¶63 (no NULL/anon/unauthorised), Tabla 4-1 (TLS 1.2 authorised suites) and Tabla 4-2 (TLS 1.3 authorised suites); §3 tables 3-2 (RSA) and 3-4 (curves); ¶25 (SHA-1). Legal basis: RD 311/2022 (ENS) mp.com. Effective strength for category MEDIA/ALTA per the R category (≥128 bits).
summary: The Spanish public-sector baseline. TLS 1.2/1.3 with the Recomendado cipher suites of Tables 4-1/4-2, RSA >= 3000-bit certificates, 128-bit strength.
notes: ¶61: 'Deberán utilizarse versiones de TLS 1.2 y 1.3 y no se autoriza el uso de versiones TLS inferiores.' cipher_suites.allow is the Recomendado (R) rows only: the eight ECDHE AEAD suites in Tabla 4-1 marked R, plus all five TLS 1.3 suites of Tabla 4-2 (all marked R). The Legacy (L) rows of Tabla 4-1 (the CBC, DHE and static-RSA suites) are omitted because §3 ¶10 defines the L category with 'periodo de validez hasta 2025 (31 de [diciembre])', a window that has now closed. ChaCha20-Poly1305 IS authorised (¶50 and Tabla 4-2), unlike BSI/FIPS. ¶63 forbids NULL/anon suites and any suite whose primitives are not authorised in §3 (RC4, IDEA, DES...), which the allowlist enforces implicitly. minimum_security_strength 128: the R category is 'una fortaleza [...] de 128 bits o más'. certificate min_rsa_bits 3000: Tabla 3-2 R row 'n >= 3000'; min_ec_bits 256: Tabla 3-4 R curves (Brainpool/NIST P-256 and up). disallow_sha1: ¶25 'No se autoriza el uso de la función SHA-1, salvo en construcciones HMAC'. FLAG: CCN's RSA floor is 'n >= 3000', very slightly below NIST's 3072->128-bit threshold used by strength.py, so a hypothetical 3000-3071-bit RSA key (not used in practice) could trip the strength gate while passing min_rsa_bits; real 3072-bit keys satisfy both. Certification under op.pl.5 (CPSTIC) cannot be checked over the network.
